newsitem.title: UK: Cotton enquiry seen in several European centres.
newsitem.headline: Cotton enquiry seen in several European centres.

text.p: Enquiry continued to be noted in several European cotton markets, principally for upland better qualities to cover shipment requirements during the next few months, traders said.
Recent transactions have focused on Central Asia types, though some sellers are apparently now less willing to offer high grades prior to the turn of the year and sometimes even further forward.
Mill buying interest has also been shown for additional quantities of West African styles and Spanish top grades.
Overall, the tempo of new business continues to be restricted owing to the rather unclear outlook for prices.
